seo.title: 3-Day Desert Tour from Fes to Marrakech | Erg Chebbi & Atlas (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €310 pp. 3-day desert tour from Fes to Marrakech via Merzouga (private or shared). Middle Atlas cedar forest, Erg Chebbi camel trek, Ait Ben Haddou & local guide.
seo.lead: This three-day point-to-point route connects Fes to Marrakech via the Sahara Desert, saving you from having to backtrack across the country. Leaving Fes in the morning, you cross the Middle Atlas Mountains through alpine Ifrane and the cedar forests of Azrou before descending the palm-filled Ziz Valley to Merzouga for a sunset camel ride and desert camp overnight. The final two days turn west through Todra Gorges, the Dades Valley, and Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou, finishing over the High Atlas Mountains in Marrakech.

highlights: Cross the Middle Atlas Mountains via Ifrane and the Azrou cedar forest
Spot wild Barbary macaques in their natural woodland habitat
Drive through the Ziz Valley oasis on the way to the Sahara
Sunset and sunrise camel rides in the Erg Chebbi dunes
Overnight in a desert camp with Moroccan tagines and campfire music
Walk through Todra Gorges and explore Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou before reaching Marrakech

faqs.question: Is this a direct one-way trip from Fes to Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pick you up at your accommodation in Fes on Day 1 and drop you off at your hotel or riad in Marrakech on Day 3.

faqs.question: How long is the drive on Day 1 from Fes to Merzouga?
faqs.answer: It covers roughly 470 km (about 7.5 to 8 hours). The drive is paced with regular stops in Ifrane, the Azrou cedar forest, Midelt for lunch, and panoramic viewpoints over the Ziz Valley before reaching the dunes in the late afternoon.

faqs.question: What happens to our large suitcases during the camel ride?
faqs.answer: Your main luggage stays safely locked inside your private vehicle or is driven directly to the desert camp by 4x4 support. You only need to carry a small backpack on the camel.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Standard and Luxury camps?
faqs.answer: Standard camps provide private furnished tents with shared bathroom facilities. Luxury camps offer spacious tents with private en-suite hot showers, flush toilets, and charging outlets.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate special dietary needs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free meals are easily arranged at both the riad and the desert camp if mentioned at booking.
